title: Dev — Bugfix
description: Non-emergency bugfix workflow: reproduce issue, confirm root cause, implement minimal fix, then verify regression safety.

steps.title: Root cause investigation
steps.notes: Find root cause before attempting fix; reproduce failing test and record root-cause notes in .vibe/research/<task-id>.md.
verify_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const active=path.join(root,'.vibe','active.json');const legacy=path.join(root,'.vibe','state.json');let st;if(fs.existsSync(active)){const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(active,'utf8'));const seg=p.session_segment;if(!seg||typeof seg!=='string'){console.error('Invalid .vibe/active.json');process.exit(1);}const sp=path.join(root,'.vibe','sessions',seg,'state.json');if(!fs.existsSync(sp)){console.error('Missing session state: '+sp);process.exit(1);}st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sp,'utf8'));}else if(fs.existsSync(legacy)){st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(legacy,'utf8'));}else{console.error('No Vibe state: expected .vibe/active.json + .vibe/sessions/<segment>/state.json, or legacy .vibe/state.json');process.exit(1);}const id=String(st.task_id||'').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g,'_');const f=path.join(root,'.vibe/research',id+'.md');if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('Missing research file: '+f);process.exit(1);}const b=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!/(root cause|nguyen nhan goc|nguyên nhân gốc)/i.test(b)){console.error('Record root-cause notes in .vibe/research/<task-id>.md before implementation.');process.exit(1);}"

steps.title: Bugfix implementation
steps.notes: Follow systematic debug hypothesis; TDD for fix verification. Keep patch minimal and avoid unrelated refactors.

steps.title: Fix + test
steps.notes: Minimal fix; run related tests + smoke regression.
